final: SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points, AVG(ds.points) - (SELECT AVG(per_race_name.avg_points) FROM (SELECT AVG(ds2.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings ds2 JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = ds2.raceId WHERE ds2.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r2.name) AS per_race_name) AS difference_from_overall_average FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name HAVING AVG(ds.points) > (SELECT AVG(per_race_name.avg_points) FROM (SELECT AVG(ds2.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings ds2 JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = ds2.raceId WHERE ds2.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r2.name) AS per_race_name)
